title: refactor: modularize community endpoint policy
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Splits the 1,487-line route into HTTP orchestration plus focused schema, proxy-policy, fallback, and presenter modules.
- Derives create and update policy with pure functions and a declarative price-limit table.
- Shares one fallback eligibility rule between candidate listing and write validation.
- Preserves encryption, fallback resolution, publishing checks, response shapes, and database ordering.
- Adds transition coverage for image pricing, private visibility, advertised metadata clearing, and listing-only updates.

Checks:
- TypeScript: passed
- Biome: passed
- All five community-endpoint test files: 29 tests passed

Replaces #13763 with the same behavior-focused change reconstructed on current main.

gist.headline: The endpoint garden got pruned
gist.blurb: The community endpoint route stopped carrying 1,487 lines in one tiny wheelbarrow. Its policy rules now live in smaller, testable beds without changing the harvest.
gist.summary: Refactored the 1,487-line community-endpoints route into schema, proxy-policy, fallback, and presenter modules, with shared fallback eligibility and declarative create/update price-limit policies.
gist.impact: Community endpoint behavior, including encryption, publishing checks, fallback resolution, response shapes, and database ordering, remains consistent while future policy changes gain focused transition coverage.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a cozy garden where one overgrown code-vine has been carefully separated into four labeled flower pots for schemas, proxy policy, fallbacks, and presentation. A helpful CRT robot compares matching fallback paths on a clipboard, showing that the reorganized garden still leads to the same endpoint.
